## Objective

What problem does this EPIC solve and what capability does it deliver?

## Scope

List the files or directories that will be created or modified. Explicitly state what is not in scope.

## Requirements

Enumerate specific, measurable requirements. Each requirement must be verifiable.

## Constraints

Document architectural, technical, or process constraints. Reference the Baseline where applicable.

## Verification

Describe how each requirement will be verified. Reference the evidence hierarchy.

## Deliverable

Describe the final artifact that the EPIC produces.
